referenceSources.description:
A white Opel Astra GSI rally car, marked with the number 57 and SACHS logos, powers through a rural stage. The car’s vibrant yellow, red, and blue graphics contrast against its white body and multi‑spoke rally wheels. A roof vent and front license plate "KG SH 11" add to its competition‑ready appearance.

This image appears on a fiberglass body kit supplier’s webpage, which offers parts for the Opel Astra F GSI. The site lists hoods, tailgates, fenders, fog light brackets, headlight grills, Wesem lamps, DZUS fasteners, Sparco clips, steel mounting rods, and polycarbonate window kits, each with reference codes and prices in euros (excluding VAT and shipping).
